name: prompteye
description: See how visible a brand is inside the answers AI assistants give — visibility, competitors, prompts and the sources behind the numbers.
long_description:
PromptEye tracks how often AI assistants name a brand when they answer buying questions. Pick a project — one brand tracked in one market — then ask how visible it is, which competitors answer alongside it, which prompts carry it, what the assistants actually wrote, and which pages they leaned on.

With an API key, the account, projects, knowledge base, categories and prompt suggestions come from PromptEye; the remaining tools answer from sample data until the API serves them. Without a key everything answers from sample data.

api_key.title: PromptEye API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://app.prompteye.com/integrations. It starts with pe_live_ and needs the api_access scope.

base_url.title: API base URL
base_url.description: The API URL of the deployment the key belongs to. Copy it from https://app.prompteye.com/integrations, next to the key.
